Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • Narrow a search in one click. Search results now have Unread, Starred, Has Files and date (past week, month or year) buttons. No Gmail search codes needed.
  • Saved searches. Click Save Search on any search and it appears under Saved Searches in the sidebar. Click it to run it again with the same filters, or right-click to remove it.
  • New Senders is now in the sidebar, next to Contacts and Subscriptions.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

Bug fixes

  • A reply sent from a notification or the notch now joins its conversation. Before, it could start a separate new conversation in your Inbox. It also now quotes the original message like other replies do.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • New senders. Email from someone you've never written to, and who hasn't been writing to you for long, gets a New tag. The top of the Inbox shows "3 new senders · Review", which opens View › New Senders. From there you can:

- Allow a sender, which treats them like everyone else from then on;
- Archive their conversations.

  • Optional: hide new senders from the Inbox. Turn this on in Settings › General › Privacy and first-time senders wait in New Senders until you allow them. It's off by default, and nothing is archived or deleted in Gmail.
